description: Add button press feedback using PressableScale, view toggle crossfade animations, and progress bar width animations. Leverages existing PressableScale component for buttons and creates CrossfadeView wrapper for view transitions.
steps: 1. Create src/components/motion/CrossfadeView.tsx: A wrapper that crossfades between children when a 'viewKey' prop changes. Use useSharedValue for opacity, useAnimatedStyle, FadeIn/FadeOut entering/exiting layout animations from Reanimated. Duration ~200ms. Respect useMotion().reducedMotion.
2. Export CrossfadeView from src/components/motion/index.ts barrel file.
3. In app/(tabs)/today.tsx: Import CrossfadeView. Wrap the conditional render of DayTimeline vs task list (viewMode === 'timeline' ? ... : ...) with CrossfadeView, passing viewKey={viewMode}.
4. In app/(tabs)/index.tsx: Import CrossfadeView. Wrap the conditional render of scheduleViewMode (timeline vs list in Today's Schedule card) with CrossfadeView, passing viewKey={scheduleViewMode}.
5. In app/(tabs)/calendar.tsx: The DayPanel component already has panelViewMode state. Wrap the task list / timeline conditional with CrossfadeView, passing viewKey={panelViewMode}.

6. In app/(tabs)/index.tsx: Find the focusProgressFill View inside the Today's Focus card. Add animated width using useSharedValue initialized to todayProgress.percent, useAnimatedStyle with width: `${progressWidth.value}%`. When todayProgress.percent changes, animate with withTiming(250ms).

7. Replace key Pressable buttons with PressableScale from src/components/motion/PressableScale.tsx: In src/components/DailyNotes.tsx replace the expand/collapse Pressable. In src/components/navigation/NavigationBar.tsx replace TabItem Pressable. Keep existing accessibilityRole and styles.
8. In app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx: Consider replacing view toggle button Pressables in both SidebarLayout and NativeTabLayoutInner with PressableScale for consistent feedback.
9. Ensure all CrossfadeView usage handles empty states gracefully (no animation if only one child ever renders).
acceptance_criteria: View toggle between list and timeline shows smooth crossfade (opacity transition)
Progress bar in Focus card animates width changes smoothly
DailyNotes expand button has subtle press scale feedback
NavigationBar tabs have subtle press scale feedback
Animations skip when reduced motion is enabled
No layout jumps or flicker during view transitions
verification: Manual test: Toggle list/timeline view on Today screen — verify crossfade animation
Manual test: Toggle list/timeline view on Home screen schedule card — verify crossfade
Manual test: Toggle list/timeline view on Calendar day panel — verify crossfade
Manual test: Complete tasks to change progress — verify Focus card progress bar animates
Manual test: Tap nav bar buttons — verify subtle scale down on press
findings: Implemented all FEAT-002 animations: 1) Created CrossfadeView component that fades out to 0 opacity (half duration), updates children, then fades in (half duration). Uses useMotion().getDuration() for reduced motion support. 2) Added CrossfadeView to today.tsx, index.tsx (Home), and calendar.tsx (DayPanel) for list/timeline view toggles. 3) Added animated progress bar to Focus card in index.tsx using useSharedValue and useAnimatedStyle with withTiming(250ms). 4) Replaced Pressables with PressableScale in DailyNotes.tsx (expand/collapse button) and NavigationBar.tsx (all TabItems including Profile). Removed unused tabPressed style from NavigationBar. All animations respect reduced motion settings via useMotion hook.
